color.$description: Two colours, no accent. Primitives hold the only hex values; themes and the avatar tile reference them.

ink.$description: Ink: the wordmark and mark on a light ground, and the ground of the favicon and the social preview.

paper.$description: Paper: the light ground, and the wordmark and mark on an ink ground.

tile.$description: Ink lifted for the avatar tile, so the round avatar keeps an edge on a dark page. Used for the avatar only.

github-light.$description: Not a brand colour: the light page ground GitHub shows the wordmark and avatar on. Kept to check contrast.

github-dark.$description: Not a brand colour: the dark page ground GitHub shows the wordmark and avatar on. Kept to check contrast.

avatar-tile.$description: Ground of the avatar, behind a paper mark.
